versions.changelog: Add model provider configuration documentation and common error solutions. Include: (1) How to configure model providers, (2) Choose between using same model as main agent or configuring new provider, (3) Configure models.providers in openclaw.json, (4) Configure agent-specific auth-profiles.json, (5) Common errors and solutions for provider name mismatches, missing API keys, and configuration issues.
Fix workspace path examples to use independent workspaces by default (workspace-<agent-name>) instead of the incorrect ~/.openclaw/workspaces/ path
